description: Export resize (recording plan R2, R-090 P4/P8, decision 100) on the 2x2 plane grid at 256 px, s1 set to 256 x 128 per texture set: one fill per set with BaseColor, User0 (RGB16), Height (height ramps) and Normal (normal-a): s0 field A and the 64 px pattern, Nearest; s1 the same, BilinearHQ; s2 the impulse texel (one white texel at (100, 37)) on both, Nearest; s3 a uniform (0.8, 0.3, 0.1) and the impulse texel, BilinearHQ. sizeLog2 6, 7, 9, 10 (PNG 16 and OpenEXR 32f, infinite), PNG 8 at 7, passthrough at 7 and 9 (PNG 16); every export step done twice in the session. Probes: sizeLog2 as [9, 7], [7, 9], [8, 8], [8, 7], [7, 8], and sizeLog2 14 on s3's BaseColor (PNG 8).
